theorem ownCCSt_post [package_sem : Assumptions] (cfg : tracker.Config) (prsm : Loc) (s' : CCState)
    : ownCCSt cfg prsm s' ⊢ ∃ prs, ownCfgCC cfg (DFrac.own 1) s'.cfg ∗ ownMap prsm (DFrac.own 1) prs
    ∗ ⌜prs.domSet = s'.prs.domSet⌝ ∗ [∗map] k ↦ pr ∈ prs, iprop(∃ p, ownProgress pr p ∗ ⌜s'.prs !! k
    = some p.learner⌝)

theorem ownCCSt_of_result [package_sem : Assumptions] (chg : confchange.Changer) (base : GMap w64
    tracker.Progress) (cfg : tracker.Config) (trk : Loc) (s : CCState) : (ownCfgCC cfg (DFrac.own 1)
    s.cfg ∗ ownPrsW chg base trk s.prs ∗ [∗map] pv ∈ base, progR2 pv) ⊢ ownCCSt cfg trk s

def restoreInv (chg : confchange.Changer) (v0 : Loc) (sops : List ConfChangeSingleM) (s' : CCState)
    (j : Nat) (cfg : tracker.Config) (prs : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ownMap v0 (DFrac.own 1) ∅ ∗
      (⌜j = 0 ∧ cfg = chg.Tracker'.Config' ∧ prs = chg.Tracker'.Progress'⌝ ∨
        ⌜0 < j⌝ ∗ ∃ s, ⌜RestoreAt sops s' j s⌝ ∗ ownCCSt cfg prs s))

theorem ownCCSt_step [package_sem : Assumptions] (chg : confchange.Changer) (s' : CCState) (r :
    Option CCState) (Hr : r = some s') (cfg : tracker.Config) (trk : Loc) (err : GoInterface) (base
    : GMap w64 tracker.Progress) : (ownResult chg base r cfg trk err ∗ [∗map] pv ∈ base, progR2 pv)
    ⊢ ⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗ ownCCSt cfg trk s'

theorem progs_of_values [package_sem : Assumptions] (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (pvs : GMap w64
    tracker.Progress) (P : w64 → Bool → Prop) (Hdom : ∀ (k : w64), (prs !! k).isSome = true ↔ (pvs
    !! k).isSome = true) (HP : ∀ (k : w64) (pv : tracker.Progress), pvs !! k = some pv → P k
    pv.IsLearner') : (([∗map] pr;pv ∈ prs;pvs, typedPointsto pr pv (DFrac.own 1)) ∗ [∗map] pv ∈ pvs,
    progR2 pv) ⊢ [∗map] k ↦ pr ∈ prs, iprop(∃ pp, ownProgress pr pp ∗ ⌜P k pp.learner⌝)

theorem ccState_flags (s : CCState) (pvs : GMap w64 tracker.Progress) (Hfl : flagsOf pvs = s.prs) :
    { cfg := s.cfg, prs := flagsOf pvs } = s

def ownCCSt (cfg : tracker.Config) (prsm : Loc) (s : CCState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ prs pvs,
      ownCfgCC cfg (DFrac.own 1) s.cfg ∗
        ownMap prsm (DFrac.own 1) prs ∗
          ([∗map] pr;pv ∈ prs;pvs, typedPointsto pr pv (DFrac.own 1)) ∗
            ([∗map] pv ∈ pvs, progR2 pv) ∗ ⌜flagsOf pvs = s.prs⌝)

def progR2 (pv : tracker.Progress) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ pp, ownInflights pv.Inflights' pp.infl ∗ ⌜progressAbs pv pp.infl = some pp⌝)

def RestoreAt (sops : List ConfChangeSingleM) (s' : CCState) (j : Nat) (s : CCState) : Prop :=
  j ≤ sops.length ∧ simpleFold (List.take j sops) (cfgState ∅ ∅) = some s ∨ j = sops.length + 1 ∧ s = s'
